summary: Radar for 2026-10-18, GLP-1 focus. Retatrutide is the strongest signal again. A CBS News investigation found the FDA received 2 death reports in 2026 tied to bootleg 'retatrutide'. Futurism, NY Post, NewsNation and Gizmodo picked it up, and Lilly has filed lawsuits against sellers. Searches like 'is retatrutide approved' keep appearing. This fits our proven 'what's confirmed?' lane. Lilly reported TRIUMPH-2/3 results on Jul 23, 2026 and plans to file with the FDA in Q1 2027, so retatrutide is not FDA-approved as of Oct 2026. Lilly's Q3 earnings around Oct 29 set the peak window for a retatrutide long-form decoder. The freshest research hook is an ANESTHESIOLOGY 2026 abstract using 2.03M Epic Cosmos records of elective surgery. GLP-1 use was linked to 11% lower odds of major heart complications and 8% lower odds of infections. It's observational and doesn't prove cause and effect. News coverage is rising (Newsweek, Medical Xpress) and creator coverage is still thin. A new head-to-head opens with Wegovy HD: semaglutide 7.2 mg has been FDA-approved since Mar 2026, with 20.7% at 72 weeks in STEP UP, and it's at the centre of Novo's ad lawsuit against Lilly. Before scripting, check whether 20.7% is the trial-product figure; the lawsuit coverage cites about 19%. SURMOUNT-5 follow-ups still hold steady demand. Rejected: anorexia and telehealth stories, compounded-switching how-tos, low-dose tirzepatide strategy (dosing), the Philippine FDA vial advisory (it draws buyers) and 'does tirzepatide cause breast cancer' (scare bait). Orforglipron stays long-form only, and carousels are not recommended.

candidates.topic: Is bootleg 'retatrutide' safe? The FDA received 2 death reports in 2026 linked to products sold as retatrutide (CBS News, Oct 2026). Retatrutide is still not FDA-approved as of Oct 2026
candidates.angle: A calm 'what's confirmed?' Short. The FDA received 2 reports (July and September). Reports alone can't prove the product caused the deaths, and nobody knows what was actually in the vials. Lilly says neither person was in a trial and calls these products black-market. The real drug is in trials, and Lilly plans to file with the FDA in Q1 2027. Close by pointing to a prescriber. Never name a seller or say how to get it. No emoji.
candidates.why_now: CBS broke the story around Oct 13. Futurism (Oct 17), NY Post (Oct 16), NewsNation and Gizmodo followed, and the news feed is full of 'fda concerns unapproved glp-1 retatrutide' queries. Our retatrutide Shorts have a median of 98 YouTube views, about 1.75× our usual level.

evidence.signal: FDA received at least 2 death reports linked to products claimed to be retatrutide; details unverified
Second report involved severe dehydration, malnutrition and cardiac arrest; causation unclear
Pickup by consumer science press on Oct 17
Mainstream tech and science coverage of the black-market risk

candidates.topic: Is retatrutide approved yet? (Oct 2026) Not yet. Lilly reported Phase 3 TRIUMPH-2 and TRIUMPH-3 results on Jul 23, 2026 and plans to file with the FDA in Q1 2027
candidates.angle: A dated status question, our best Instagram format. Not approved by the FDA, MHRA, Health Canada or TGA as of Oct 2026. Give Lilly's filing plan (moved from late 2026 to Q1 2027 for manufacturing data) and what TRIUMPH showed. In TRIUMPH-2 (type 2 diabetes with obesity or overweight), the top dose gave up to 20.8% average weight loss at 80 weeks. Close by pointing to a prescriber.
candidates.why_now: The news feed shows '2026 fda approved weight loss drug retatrutide approval status' and 'is retatrutide a weight loss drug'. Stocktwits reports Lilly's CEO calling retatrutide the next growth driver. The death-report news is pushing status searches up.

evidence.signal: Retatrutide met Phase 3 weight-loss endpoints in TRIUMPH-2 and TRIUMPH-3 at 80 weeks
BLA submission planned for Q1 2027

candidates.topic: Did retatrutide beat tirzepatide? Decoder ahead of Lilly's Q3 earnings: TRIUMPH-2 (up to 20.8% at 80 weeks, type 2 diabetes with obesity or overweight) and TRIUMPH-3 (up to 22.6%, severe obesity with heart disease)
candidates.angle: A long-form decoder in our breakout format: 'Did retatrutide beat tirzepatide? [one number]'. Explain the triple hormone mechanism (GIP, GLP-1, glucagon), each trial's population, its side effects, and why cross-trial comparisons aren't head-to-heads. Give the dated status. Write 'Lilly reported' throughout.
candidates.why_now: Earnings around Oct 29 plus the bootleg news create demand for a trustworthy explainer. Decoders of next-gen drugs are our only long-form lane that travels (median ~32, EloraTZP 396).

evidence.signal: TRIUMPH-2: 20.8%, TRIUMPH-3: 22.6% at 80 weeks on the highest dose (Lilly topline)

candidates.topic: Do GLP-1 medicines make surgery safer? 2.03 million elective-surgery records linked GLP-1 use to 11% lower odds of major heart complications and 8% lower odds of infections (ANESTHESIOLOGY 2026, observational)
candidates.angle: 'Having surgery on Mounjaro or Wegovy?' Give the reassuring new association, say clearly that it doesn't prove cause and effect, and add the practical takeaway: tell your surgeon and anesthesia team you're on a GLP-1 (this builds on our anesthesia Short, which got 83). Population: adults having elective surgery over 60 minutes with at least a 24-hour stay, 145,610 GLP-1 users matched with non-users. Give no stopping or holding advice; send people to their surgical team.
candidates.why_now: Published Oct 18 via Medical Xpress, Newsweek and Inside Precision Medicine. It adds to knee, hip and shoulder arthroplasty papers from this week. Health creators haven't covered it yet.

evidence.signal: 2,028,601 patients; 11% lower odds of MACE and 8% lower odds of infection; lead researcher says it doesn't prove cause and effect

candidates.topic: Semaglutide 7.2 mg (Wegovy HD) vs tirzepatide (Zepbound): what the trials actually showed, and why Novo is suing Lilly over the ads

These are separate trials, not a head-to-head; SURMOUNT-5 compared tirzepatide only with semaglutide 2.4 mg. Explain the ad dispute neutrally. Include the 'don't switch or stop on your own' line. Re-check the 20.7% estimand and also give the treatment-policy figure.
